entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Office has raised an objection that in fact a Miscellaneous Appeal should have been filed in place of Civil Revision.

It is submitted by counsel for applicant that either he may granted a week's time to file an application seeking permission of this Court to convert this Civil Revision into Miscellaneous Appeal or his verbal prayer for conversion of this Civil Revision into Miscellaneous Appeal may be accepted.
Considered the submissions made by counsel for applicant.
The applicant has filed this civil revision for enhancement of compensation amount.
Therefore, verbal prayer made by counsel for applicant for conversion of this Civil Revision into Miscellaneous Appeal is allowed.

Accordingly, subject to payment of Court fees within a period of two weeks' from today, office is directed to register this case in the category of Miscellaneous Appeal under Section 173 of Motor Vehicles Act.
With aforesaid observation, this Civil Revision is disposed of.
